values.note: About 225 sites take an RV or trailer, roughly 178 of them 23 ft or longer; 48 are tent-only. Electric sites are the 12-13 accessible sites in loop J (180-185, 196-202). 10 group sites are not counted.

sites.source: recreation.gov 258830 catalog (341 units: 330 individual + 11 group-loop; permitted-equipment lengths), NPS data API (rvMaxLength 45; '324 individual campsites, 10 large group sites, and 13 electric-only ADA-accessible sites'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Coin showers and laundry are at the Colter Bay Village launderette, for a fee; free dump and water fill station.

facilities.source: NPS data API amenities (flush toilets, coin-operated showers, laundry, dump station, camp store, potable water; rvInfo 'complimentary dump station and a water fill station') + recreation.gov 258830 facility text, read 2026-11-20

season.source: NPS data API operatingHours: 'Winter Closure' 2026-09-27 to 2027-05-21 (2027 closing date not yet posted; recreation.gov's 2027 peak rate season runs 05-21 to 09-30), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Reservation only (hiker/biker sites aside); 30 nights a year across all Grand Teton campgrounds.

booking.source: NPS page banner 'All park campgrounds are by advanced reservations only' + data API (numberOfSitesFirstComeFirstServe 0; 'maximum stay ... 14 nights ... cumulative ... 30 nights'); recreation.gov maxConsecutiveStay 14, read 2026-11-20

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258830/rates - Peak Season 2027-05-21..2027-09-30: StandardNonelectric 60, StandardElectric 89, read 2026-11-20 (the NPS data API lists $59 / $80)

discounts.source: recreation.gov 258830 overview: 'Please note this is a concession run campground and sites are not eligible for America the Beautiful or Senior Pass discounts.' read 2026-11-20

note: Large concession-run campground (Grand Teton Lodge Company) in lodgepole pine at Colter Bay Village, a short walk from Jackson Lake but not on the shore; visitor center, stores, restaurants and the Colter Bay RV Park next door. Generators only in loops H, J, K, M and O, 6 am-10 pm. Bears frequent the area; food lockers at the sites. --Claude
summary: NPS data API + rec.gov 258830: 330 individual sites (about 225 take an RV, ~178 at 23 ft+), max 45 ft; electric only on the 12-13 accessible loop-J sites; reservation-only, 14 nights; open 05-21 to 09-26 (2026 closure date); rec.gov $60-$89 (NPS $59/$80); concession - no Senior Pass discount. Not waterfront confirmed (NPS: 'not on the shores of Jackson Lake'). Pin ~320 m E of the loops -> move. Phone empty -> 307-543-3020.
flags: PIN MOVE (~320 m): stored 43.90882,-110.64161 is on the main access road east of the loops; catalog centroid of 331 sites is 43.91097,-110.64427. Suggested pin 43.9110,-110.6443.

HOOKUPS (not changed): stored electric 50 (RIDB) comes only from the 12 'STANDARD ELECTRIC' sites in loop J (180-185, 196-202), all flagged accessible; the NPS calls them '13 electric-only ADA-accessible sites'. If accessible sites count as not open to the general public, electric should be unknown - reviewer's call.
